html:
An English explorer and naturalist whose travels through the Carolina backcountry in 1700 and 1701 produced one of the best early accounts of its Native peoples. His death at the hands of the Tuscarora began the Tuscarora War.

From Charles Town in South Carolina he made a two-month loop through the Piedmont with Native guides, staying with the Congaree, Sugaree, Waxhaw, Catawba, Keyauwee, Eno and others. His book A New Voyage to Carolina (1709) describes their towns, food and customs, and lists coastal nations such as the Poteskeet. For several of these peoples, broken within years by disease, slave raids and the Yamasee War, it is the only close description.

As surveyor general of North Carolina he helped found Bath and New Bern. Settlers pressed onto Tuscarora land, and in 1711 the Tuscarora captured Lawson and put him to death.
sum: An English explorer and naturalist whose travels through the Carolina backcountry in 1700 and 1701 produced one of the best early accounts of its Native peoples. His death at the hands of the Tuscarora began the Tuscarora War.
